_doc: Path -> area map: the single home for which subsystem owns a file and which doc to read before changing it. Read by the coderabbit-triage skill (route each PR-bot finding: first matching route wins, so specific file patterns precede directory routes) and by issue triage (an area:<x> Issue label -> that route's docs). `python3 agent-layer/agents/scripts/core/coderabbit-triage.py area <path>...` prints the route for a path; its `selftest` validates this file (every doc path exists, area names unique). Every non-null `area` must have a matching area:<x> label in agent-layer/agents/scripts/project/issue-labels.manifest and vice versa (sync-issue-labels.sh --check-parity). `generic_areas` lists area labels that own no path. A route with area null has no Issue label. Paths and docs are relative to the repo root; globs: `**/` = any directories, `*` = within one path segment, `{a,b}` = alternatives. A file no route matches has no owning area: read the nearest leaf AGENTS.md (CONTEXT-MAP.md) and agent-layer/docs/agent-rules/cpp-rules.md.
